listing.name: KSP Characters
listing.abstract: Adds the Kerbal from Kerbal Space Program as a crew character, with KSP's own models, textures and animations.
listing.description:
Adds the Kerbal from Kerbal Space Program as a playable crew character: body, helmet, visor, the game's own jetpack, and KSP's own animations.

Kerbals join the pool the game draws crew from, so new crew members are a random mix of kittens and Kerbals. Saves that already exist keep the characters they have.

It is a data mod: no code and no mod loader.

## Known limitations

- The jetpack keeps one floating pose whatever the thrust, as in KSP.
- The face has no expressions or blinking, and the eyes play KSP's own animation instead of following the camera.
- The seated pose doesn't move.
- Kerbals get kitten names.
- The walk plays faster than in KSP, because KSA moves crew faster. It is slowed down as far as data alone allows.

## Credits and legal

The Kerbal's models, textures and animations come from Kerbal Space Program and belong to its rights holders. The jetpack and its textures are Kitten Space Agency's. This is a fan port, not affiliated with or endorsed by either. Only the XML definitions and the documentation are MIT licensed; see LICENSE.
